release_rotation=tube_pose[:3,:3].copy()
release_endpoints=np.array([[0,-.0455,0],[0,.0525,0]])
release_pixels=np.array([[975,786],[977,883]])

print('Release pose estimate',release_fit.x,'pixel residual',release_fit.fun)
